versions.content: For each configured Time Master (refer to FrTSynGlobal- TimeMaster ) the FrTSyn module shall periodically transmit SYNC messages with the 24 of 71 Document ID 675: AUTOSAR_SWS_TimeSyncOverFlexRay Specification of Time Synchronization over FlexRay AUTOSAR CP R21-11 cycle FrTSynGlobalTimeTxPeriod including the time value, which will be valid at the start of the next FlexRay cycle 0 and User Data, if the GLOBAL_TIME_BASE bit within the timeBaseStatus is set and FrTSynGlobalTimeTxPeriod is unequal to 0 and if the associated cyclicMsgResumeCounter is not running. The cyclic transmission shall be started in the earliest possible FrT- Syn_MainFunction call once the requirements above are fulfilled.
